newsitem.title: USA: Intl Alliance to make $32.9 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: Intl Alliance to make $32.9 mln placement.

text.p: International Alliance Services Inc said on Friday that it has accepted subscriptions to sell about 3.9 million units at a price of $9.00 per unit in a private placement, resulitng in net proceeds of $32.9 million.

Each unit is comprised of one share of common stock of the company and one warrant to purchase one share of common stock of the Company at an exercise price of $11.00 per share, exercisable for a three year period beginning on the closing date.
The private placement is anticipated to close on December 30, 1996.

Included in the 3.9 million units to be sold in the private placement, the company accepted subscriptions to sell 555,556 units to MGD Holdings Ltd, a Bermuda company controlled by Michael DeGroote, chairman of the company.
Also included are an aggregate of 61,055 units to Harve Ferrill and Richard Rochon, directors of the company.
These agreements are subject to stockholder approval.
